sites.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sites (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

users.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	`role` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	failed_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	locked_until DATETIME, 
	token_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)

audit_logs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	detail VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

devices.ddl:
CREATE TABLE devices (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	device_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	site_id INTEGER, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	hw_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	fw_version VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	config_applied_version INTEGER, 
	online BOOL NOT NULL, 
	last_seen DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (device_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(site_id) REFERENCES sites (id)
)

alert_rules.ddl:
CREATE TABLE alert_rules (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	params_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOL NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_alert_rule_type UNIQUE (device_id, type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id)
)

commands.ddl:
CREATE TABLE commands (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	cmd_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	params_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	sent_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, 
	acked_at DATETIME(3), 
	reason VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (cmd_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_commands_device_sent ON commands (device_id, sent_at)

device_configs.ddl:
CREATE TABLE device_configs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	`key` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	updated_by INTEGER, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_device_config_key UNIQUE (device_id, `key`), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

device_credentials.ddl:
CREATE TABLE device_credentials (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mqtt_username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	secret_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (device_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id), 
	UNIQUE (mqtt_username)
)

telemetry.ddl:
CREATE TABLE telemetry (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	boot_id VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	seq BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	ts DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, 
	distance_cm FLOAT, 
	level_pct FLOAT, 
	flow_lpm FLOAT, 
	flow_total_l FLOAT, 
	pump_on BOOL, 
	rssi INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_telemetry_dedupe UNIQUE (device_id, boot_id, seq), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_telemetry_device_ts ON telemetry (device_id, ts)

user_devices.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_devices (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, device_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id)
)

alerts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE alerts (
	id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
	device_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rule_id INTEGER, 
	type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	value FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	opened_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, 
	acked_by INTEGER, 
	acked_at DATETIME(3), 
	closed_at DATETIME(3), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(device_id) REFERENCES devices (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rule_id) REFERENCES alert_rules (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(acked_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_alerts_device_state ON alerts (device_id, state)
